title: Late-Arrival Fees on an Appointment Series
content:
**Desk guidance — Patient Services Center.**

**When the fee applies.** A late-arrival fee on an Appointment Series is charged where, on a format whose late arrival beyond the grace period is recorded as a late cancellation, the patient reached a booked appointment later than the format's grace period after its start, so that the visit was not held. The arrival is recorded as a cancellation with zero hours of notice that carries the minutes late; the fee is charged under the late-cancellation kind, and it is worked out on the most recent such zero-notice entry on the series. On a format whose late arrival beyond the grace period is recorded as a no-show, a late arrival is recorded as a no-show carrying the minutes late and is charged as a no-show, outside this fee.

The fee is booked as one late-arrival fee entry on the series, tied to the recorded late-arrival entry it is for, in US dollars to the cent.

**When the amount is settled.** The late-arrival fee is fixed only after a no-show recorded on the series' first appointment within its fee assessment period carries its first-appointment no-show fee entry.

**Booking the fee — `assess_late_arrival_fee_e6f6ddb6`.** The tool charges the late-arrival fee for one booked appointment the patient reached later than the grace period of the series' format, so that the visit could not be held. One call books one late-cancellation-kind fee against the patient's appointment series, tied to the recorded late-arrival entry it is for, and raises the missed-visit fees owed on that series by the amount charged; the patient sees the fee on the series' missed-visit balance and on the next statement. The tool records what it is given and makes no judgement of its own.

It is an agent-side tool: the representative unlocks `assess_late_arrival_fee_e6f6ddb6` and then calls it.

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `series_id` | text identifier — the reference number of the patient's appointment series that carries the late arrival, as returned by the appointment series lookup |
| `source_event_id` | text identifier — the reference number of the recorded late-arrival entry (a cancellation entry with zero hours of notice and the minutes late), as returned by the appointment history lookup for that series |
| `amount` | the fee to charge, in USD, a positive number given to 2 decimal places (cents); stored exactly as passed after rounding to 2 decimal places |

**What comes back.** `fee_reference` (the reference number of the new fee entry; its presence means the fee was booked), `series_id` (the series charged), `fee_kind` (always `late_cancellation`), `amount` (USD to 2 decimal places, the fee booked), `appointment_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, the date of the missed appointment), `assessed_on` (YYYY-MM-DD, the date the fee was charged) and `missed_fee_balance` (USD to 2 decimal places, the missed-visit fees owed on the series once this fee is included). No error return is defined.
